name: jigswap-vercel-cli
description: The Vercel CLI that .github/workflows/vercel-preview.yml and the production job of convex-deploy.yml run with VERCEL_TOKEN (a bump changes the prod web deploy too). Installed in CI with `npm ci --ignore-scripts` from the integrity-pinned package-lock.json next to this file; kept outside the pnpm workspace so it never enters pnpm-lock.yaml or a workspace install.
